notes_for_editor: Thin record. Two searches, the Landforms waypoint page and the NHLR Tennessee list are the only sources. No build, staffing or removal date was found. The NRHP Tennessee Division of Forestry tower listing (npgallery 64501237.pdf) does not mention Maces Hill. The Landforms code '4-23' is not explained on the site and is not interpreted. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence supports no more. A Facebook Smith County history post about Mace's Hill School (community about three miles northwest of Dixon Springs, per a search snippet) could not be read, so it is not used. The Landforms list spells the tower name 'Maces Hill'.
